description: This PHP script interacts with the TestLink API to add test cases to test plans, both with and without platform specifications. It constructs request arguments, sets up an XML-RPC client, and makes API calls to perform test case additions.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: An XML-RPC client class used to communicate with the TestLink server.

methods.name: show_api_db_sample_msg
methods.description: Displays a sample message or info about the API sample.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes a test by sending a request through the IXR_Client and returning the response.
